==English== [[Image:Gnome-applications-graphics.svg|100px|right|thumb|An image that represents image files]] ===Etymology=== From {{inh|en|enm|ymage}}, borrowed from {{der|en|fro|image}}, from {{der|en|la|imāgō||a copy, likeness, image}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*h₂eym-}}; the same PIE root is the source of {{m|la|imitari||to copy, imitate}}; see [[imitate]]. {{doublet|en|imago}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈɪm.ɪd͡ʒ/|a=RP,GA,CA,non-weak vowel}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-image.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɪm.əd͡ʒ/|a=AU,GA,weak vowel}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɘm.ɘd͡ʒ/|a=NZ}} * {{IPA|en|/ɪ.meːd͡ʒ/|a=India}} * {{hyph|en|im|age}} * {{rhymes|en|ɪmɪdʒ|s=2}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun}} # A [[visual]] or other representation of the external form of something in art. #: {{ux|en|The Bible forbids the worship of graven '''images'''.}} #* {{RQ:Holinshed Chronicles|volume=I|book=Ireland|chapter=The Thirde Booke of the Historie of Ireland, Comprising the Raigne of [[w:Henry VIII of England|Henry the Eyght]]: [...]|pages=77–78|pageref=77|column=2|passage=The Citizens in their rage, imagining that euery poſt in the Churche had bin one of y{{sup|e}} Souldyers, ſhot habbe or nabbe at randon{{sic|random}} uppe to the Roode lofte, and to the Chancell, leauing ſome of theyr arrowes ſticking in the '''Images'''.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|year=2013|month=July-August| author=[http://www.americanscientist.org/authors/detail/fenella-saunders Fenella Saunders]| url=http://www.americanscientist.org/issues/pub/2013/4/tiny-lenses-see-the-big-picture|title=Tiny Lenses See the Big Picture|magazine=w:American Scientist| passage=They also have high spatial resolution, resolving incoming '''images''' in minute detail. {{...}} Although classic science fiction films might wish you to believe otherwise, most insect eyes do not form a complete '''image''' in each facet.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140813125812/https://www.americanscientist.org/issues/pub/2013/4/tiny-lenses-see-the-big-picture}} ##{{senseid|en|picturefile}} A [[file]] on a computer containing a single frame; an image file. # A mental picture of something not real or not present. #* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-08-03|volume=408|issue=8847|url=http://www.economist.com/news/finance-and-economics/21582512-explosion-start-ups-changing-finance-better-revenge-nerds|title=Revenge of the nerds| passage=Think of banking today and the '''image''' is of grey-suited men in towering skyscrapers. Its future, however, is being shaped in converted warehouses and funky offices in San Francisco, New York and London, where bright young things in jeans and T-shirts huddle around laptops, sipping lattes or munching on free food.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170514041056/http://www.economist.com:80/news/finance-and-economics/21582512-explosion-start-ups-changing-finance-better-revenge-nerds|archivedate=14 May 2017}} # A [[statue]] or [[idol]]. # {{lb|en|computing}} A [[file]] that contains all information needed to produce a live working copy. (See {{m|en|disk image}} and {{m|en|image copy}}.) #: {{ux|en|Most game console emulators do not come with any ROM '''images''' for copyright reasons.}} # A characteristic of a person, group or company etc., style, manner of dress, how one is or wishes to be perceived by others. # {{lb|en|mathematics}} The value a [[function]] [[map]]s some [[argument]] to. #: {{ux|en|2=The number 6 is the '''image''' of 3 under f that is defined as f(x) = 2x.}} # {{lb|en|mathematics}} The [[subset]] of the [[codomain]] of a function comprising those elements that are the image of some element of its [[domain]]. #: {{ux|en|The '''image''' of this [[step function]] is the set of integers.}} # {{lb|en|radio}} A form of [[interference]]: a weaker "copy" of a strong [[signal]] that occurs at a different [[frequency]]. # {{lb|en|obsolete}} Show; appearance; cast. #* {{RQ:Dryden Aeneis|passage=The face of things a frightful '''image''' bears.}} # {{lb|en|optics}} The collection of focus points of light rays coming from a given object. #: {{hyponyms|en|real image|virtual image}} ====Synonyms==== * {{sense|representation}} {{l|en|picture}} * {{sense|mental picture}} {{l|en|idea}} * to whom we, for the time, are become as spirits and invisible!}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To create an image of. #* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Nina Avramova|title=AI technology can identify genetic diseases by looking at your face, study says|url=https://www.cnn.com/2019/01/08/health/ai-technology-to-identify-genetic-disorder-from-facial-image-intl|date=2019-01-08|passage=He added, in an email to CNN, that “the collection of increasingly large and well curated medical datasets has enabled AI tools to predict genetic mutations from '''imaging''' phenotypes reducing the burden of healthcare systems and improving the way we care for patients.” Phenotypes are observable characteristics.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20221127040650/https://www.cnn.com/2019/01/08/health/ai-technology-to-identify-genetic-disorder-from-facial-image-intl/}} # {{lb|en|transitive|computing}} To create a complete backup copy of a [[file system]] or other entity. ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|unimaged }} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|to represent symbolically}} * Bulgarian: * Finnish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to reflect}} * Bulgarian: * Chinese: * Finnish: * German: * Turkish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to create an image of}} * Chinese: * Finnish: * German: * Turkish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|computing: to create a backup copy}} * Finnish: * German: * Sindhi: * Turkish: {{trans-bottom}} ===References=== * {{R:OneLook}} * {{R:Keywords 21st}} * {{R:Keywords|page=158}} * {{R:Century}} * {{R:Webster 1913}} ===Further reading=== * {{pedia}} ===Anagrams=== * {{anagrams|en|a=aegim|Megia|gamie}} {{C|en|Visualization}}
